artist.name: INDO WAREHOUSE
artist.bio: Indo Warehouse is a record label and event series founded in 2022 by Kunal Merchant and Kahani (Armaan Gupta). They coined the term Indo House for their mix of South Asian elements with house and techno. Their first party was a 200-person night on New York's Lower East Side in February 2022, and they have since played across Europe, Asia and the Middle East, including Hï Ibiza. In 2025 they were the first South Asian electronic collective to play Coachella, with more than 25 performers on stage in weekend one.

eras.sound: Melodic house blended with South Asian music
